title: Georgia Southern University Planetarium will host a public evening showing of Space Aliens
byline: Special to Grice Connect Oct 6, 2026 8:05 AM
excerpt: Tickets are now available for the Georgia Southern University Planetarium’s upcoming Space Aliens show, with three time slots offered on Friday, October 23.
content:
Tickets are now available for the Georgia Southern University Planetarium’s upcoming Space Aliens show, with three time slots offered on Friday, October 23.

The Georgia Southern University Planetarium will host a public evening showing Space Aliens on October 23, 2026, with presentations at 6pm, 7pm, and 8pm. Tickets for the event are available now and are $5 per person.

One of the oldest questions humans have asked since looking at the sky has been if life exists beyond our planet. Follow cosmic clues from the ocean floor to a journey across the galaxy in this presentation for all ages.

The planetarium is located in the Math/Physics Building on the Georgia Southern University Statesboro Campus.Tickets must be purchased online in advance here.

Visitors are asked to arrive at least 10 minutes before their scheduled showtime. For the safety and experience of all guests, late entry will not be permitted once the doors close.

For more information about upcoming planetarium events at Georgia Southern University, please visit the Planetarium website at https://www.georgiasouthern.edu/campuses/visit/planetarium/public-events or contact the planetarium directly at [email protected].
